observations: EquipmentBehaviors.id only returns registry namespace dynasty and path, ignores NBT. Vanilla lingering_potion yields empty string. ContentProgress.reconcile accumulates only those strings; unlock(recipe) is discovery, not proof of paid crafting or exact variant entitlement.

ContentProgress.ItemCraftedEvent only awards cod4_obtain_<baseID> for ExpansionContent.SUPPLIES. Warm wine therefore has same crafted event ID as plain marching_wine. Wolf/crab charms are not supplies, reconcile can award only base tiger_claw/scale_plate. Poison smoke has no dynasty registry ID and is not awarded here. Do not substitute these as variant-specific receipts.

All four existing shapeless recipes define typed output NBT. Graywolf is tiger_claw with version1 slot0wolf_fang; crab is scale_plate version1 slot0crab_shell; warm is marching_wine cod4WarmWinetrue; smoke is vanilla lingering_potion Potionminecraft:poison +cod4PoisonSmoketrue +color7828599. Localized display Name is presentation, not authoritative identity.

InfusionMenu.request guards current owner/menu/server/table/distance/revision before action. Successful apply charges noncreative3XP + actual trait.count (both wolf/crab2), replaces shared input0 with preview and marks revision; awards only genericfirst_infusion. No per-variant durable receipt/event observed. Preview alone incurs no cost and must not advance task. Stale expectedRevision fails before debit. Creative bypass is intentional, cannot claim survival payment from it.

InfusionTraits.preview retains base.copy but rewrites known infusion slots and version1. Active validates eligibility/families/capacity/accepts; unknown material IDs ignored. Existing armor4capacity compatibility differs new native capacity. Wolf specially allowed on tiger_claw, crabARMOR accepts armor/shield/accessory. If future task allows a legitimate infusion-table route, actual validated active trait on base item is relevant; literal slot0-only comparison would exclude legitimate slot1/2 placement. Existing crafted recipe specifically slot0 remains exactrecipe identity.

InfusionBlockEntity shared persistent two-stack inventory and monotonic revision persist actual results; on menu success result still on table, not delivered to player inventory. Future criterion must decide actual paid operation vs acquired output and bind actor/table transaction; merely scanning either player inventory or preview is not equivalent.

Existing first_infusion quest10000000000F1001 is generic, nonrepeatable, no reward; get_jade dependency. Preserve its ID/progress. Existing marching wine and material nodes are prior links, not proof of derivative variant. No extra progression gate added to ordinary recipes.

ProgressionMerchant sells only eight listed base items with nested per-player daily stock; no four variant offers. MaterialBrews.gu uses LONG_POISON and cod4HeiPoGu with different color0x6C7758; this is a distinct merchant product, cannot satisfy cod4PoisonSmoke just because both are lingering poison potions.

Existing MaterialBrewGameTests24-50 exercises native result-slot payment, NBT save and discovery by code. Read-only test source is not a run receipt; no rerun/pass credit granted. Full native Forge crafting ingredient/NBT parser and event dispatch were not expanded in this review; historical runtime evidence not re-proven.
